mapper.select: SELECT performance_round_cast_id, performance_project_id, performance_round_id, performance_character_id, public_profile_id, cast_type_code, created_dttm, updated_dttm FROM performance_round_cast WHERE performance_round_cast_id = #{performanceRoundCastId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT prc.performance_round_cast_id, prc.performance_project_id, prc.performance_round_id, prc.performance_character_id, pc.name AS character_name, pc.description AS character_description, pc.importance_code AS character_importance_code, prc.public_profile_id, prc.cast_type_code FROM performance_round_cast prc JOIN performance_character pc ON pc.performance_character_id = prc.performance_character_id AND pc.performance_project_id = prc.performance_project_id WHERE prc.performance_round_id = #{performanceRoundId} ORDER BY FIELD(pc.importance_code, 'LEAD', 'SUPPORT', 'ENSEMBLE'), pc.display_order, pc.performance_character_id
